unit: A pair of independent user messages and complete original-model turns, including persisted private document rows, their identifiers and tools used in the new chat.

fde_workshop_first: Check whether the authorized mailbox supplies the actual workshop body before the model attributes actions.
A candidate-owned private document actually persists useful, sourced, reusable evidence. The profile did not contain the workshop detail.
The draft distinguishes individual work, collaborative verification, the team pilot and unknown training. No external action.
fde_workshop_second: Inspect the exact document ID produced on the first turn and whether the new conversation reads it before drafting. The catalog includes only metadata.
The customer integration answer accurately uses the established work. Training is unconfirmed. A focused follow-up or a conditional option may be appropriate.

Separate redundant rereading of established facts from a focused search for genuinely missing post-rollout training evidence. Inspect repeated queries, excessive asks or invented training. No external action.

limitations: Synthetic source and fixed lexical mailbox, isolated document storage and simulated chronology. One pair is a targeted development observation, not a rate, live Gmail-connector test or user outcome.
